_comment: Characters confirmed to be real guild members that data/competition.json's
roster pull does NOT return. Merged by scripts/bounty/extract_roster.py.
This file exists because the pull is not the guild. Treating 'absent from
the pull' as 'not a real person' already cost us once: Phyrthepali's real
96 parse was removed from the front page on 2026-07-22 on exactly that
reasoning, and it was wrong.
RULES FOR ADDING AN ENTRY:
- `evidence` is mandatory and must name a source that can be re-checked
by a human (an armory or Warcraft Logs URL), plus the date checked.
- Never invent a score, rank or item level. Anything not directly
observed stays null and fills in when the pull catches up.
- Delete an entry once the pull returns that character natively; the
extractor warns when a supplement has become redundant.
2026-07-22 UPDATE — Phyrthepali was not a one-off. Reconciling the pull
against Raider.io's live guild roster found 15 real members missing from
data/competition.json, all 15 for the same reason (see why_missing_from_pull).
The other 14 are added below. `score` is null for every one of them: the
guild-roster endpoint does not carry an M+ score, and a guessed number is
worse than an empty one.
The roster total is therefore AT LEAST 147 (pull 132 + 15). It is still a
floor: Blizzard's own guild-roster endpoint has never been called by this
project, so no source consulted so far is authoritative.

characters.name: Phyrthepali

evidence.shows: Skill Issues - Bleeding Hollow (US), Blood Elf Paladin, 8 mythic kills logged, best HPS 166,925.6, 96 parse on Imperator Averzian dated 2026-07-19
evidence.note: M+ score deliberately left null - the WCL page shows All Star points, not a Raider.io M+ score, and a guessed number is worse than an empty one.

characters.why_missing_from_pull: DIAGNOSED 2026-07-22: the roster's only live source was Warcraft Logs (wcl.fetch_guild_member_roster -> roster_cache.json). WCL's guild member list is a by-product of log uploads, not a guild roster, so a member who has not surfaced in a parsed report tagged to the guild is simply absent. This character IS in Raider.io's guild roster and was NOT in roster_cache.json.

corroborating_evidence.shows: Phyrthepali, Blood Elf Paladin, Holy, rank 99, realm Bleeding Hollow — present in the guild's Raider.io roster, absent from roster_cache.json
